T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Friday BLS NFP release forecasts cited
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

**Synopsis:**
US private payrolls rose only 38K in August per ADP, missing the 48K Reuters consensus and slowing from July's 46K. BLS JOLTS showed 1.05 job openings per unemployed person in July, signaling stable but not tightening labor conditions. The upcoming Friday BLS report is expected to show private payrolls +45K and NFP +56K, rebounding from July's surprise -23K, with unemployment steady at 4.1%. Overall, the labor market is softening moderately.
